body: @yrodiere looking at the Javadoc of the problematic class (`io.quarkus.hibernate.orm.runtime.migration.MultiTenancyStrategy`) it looks like we can remove it?

FWIW, it has been deprecated for 2 years so, yes, we can probably drop it. I suppose we need to switch to something coming from Hibernate ORM directly.

Another option would be to fix the logger initialization.

> Another option would be to fix the logger initialization.

For sure, but if we can kill two birds with one stone, that's even better :)
Last time I checked that class -- and the corresponding setting -- was still needed in some cases, unfortunately. We can look into removing it, but it's not as trivial as deleting the class.
